headline: Palantine Berm Erupts; Weathered Expanse Fight Flares Anew
war_summary: Fighting has shifted ground since the morning edition. Palantine Berm is now the busiest sector, with ten events in the past two hours and thirty-six across the day; the hex stands at three Colonial works, two Warden and two unclaimed, though its hourly casualty rates have cooled. Weathered Expanse, scene of the day's most recent event, logged three in the last two hours among seven Warden works and two unclaimed, its Warden losses accelerating in the latest hour. Marban Hollow reported fresh clashes about Checkpoint Bua, and Nevish Line two near Grief Mother, where two Colonial works face six Warden. Gutter, active overnight at Suojus, has gone quiet these two hours, its casualty rate still climbing; one Colonial work remains among six Warden. Linn Mercy stays the costliest ground, holding nine Colonial works, one Warden and one unclaimed, its two-hour casualty figures mounting even as hourly rates ease. Mooring County, wholly Warden, counted twenty-five events in the day but none in six hours. Three hundred and ninety enlistments were recorded across the day's heaviest sectors. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
